newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends mixed, awaits palm oil forum.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends mixed, awaits palm oil forum.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market ended a shade softer on liquidation ahead of the 1997/98 palm/lauric oils seminar on Saturday. Some late selling appeared after prices had drifted in a tight range on lack of participation. Trading was cautious with next week's trend depending on the outcome of the seminar.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Uncertain in fairly scattered dealing, with April 1-25 export data having little impact on the market.
"We are unsure of what's going to happen at the forum," the trader said.
Trading was also slow due to a lack of participation, with many overseas traders already here for the Saturday seminar.

"Technically, the market was trying to test the 1,280 ringgit level (July futures), but it was not successful and the high that it hit was 1,279 level," a trader said. "Some people were a bit nervous in late dealing where some selling emerged."
At the close, July futures contract eased one ringgit to 1,270 ringgit ($506.38). Next week's trend will depend largely on the outcome of the palm/laurics oil seminar, traders said.
Small falls were seen across the futures board, they said.
Volume on the futures market was 1,240 lots.
Physicals April (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,357.50 against bids of 1,352.50 after trading from 1,350 to 1,355.
April (central) saw offers at 1,330 and bids at 1,320 with trades done at 1,330 and 1,325.
May (south) was offered at 1,352.50 with bids at 1,350 with earlier trades done at 1,347.50 and 1,350. May (central) saw offers at 1,330 versus bids at 1,320.
Among refined products, May RBD palm oil was offered at $567.50, June at $557.50 and July/Aug/Sep at $547.50.
Last-half May RBD palm olein saw offers at $602.50, June at $590 and July/Aug/Sep at $575. June was traded at $587.50 and $590.
May RBD palm stearin was offered at $435 and June at $430. May/June palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $285.
